name: WOW
tagline: Eight creators, one word, and F-777 at full volume.

facts.note: Ranked #384 on the Demonlist as of 30 August 2026. GDBrowser reports 65,535 objects, which is the 16-bit ceiling its API returns for larger levels rather than a real count, so the object count is left unknown. An XL level in GDBrowser's length bucket, which is a bracket rather than a duration.

spotlight.sub: TrusTa hosted it, Kandai verified it, and F-777's Space Battle carries the whole thing.

voice.hook: A 2.1 megacollab that never stopped being fun.
voice.why:
WOW is a 2.1 megacollab hosted by TrusTa, with Eggnog, Marwec, Pennutoh, Disp, SlimJim, Splash and ChaSe building parts. It is an XL level set to F-777's Space Battle, and it plays like the era it came from — bright, loud and unembarrassed.

Kandai verified it. It has drifted a long way down the Demonlist since, to #384, which says more about how much harder the top has become than about the level.
